claim: The maximum size of an ECR image layer is 52,000 MiB according to the quota table. The quota is not adjustable.
question: What is the maximum size of an ECR image layer?
note: The What's New post of 2026-08-03 says layers pushed with Docker push can be up to 200 GB (GA after 2026-07-15, not examinable yet); this quota table still shows 52,000 MiB. See ecr-change-image-layers-200-gb-2026-08.
